# Warning text

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use warning text to alert users to an important consequence of an action or inaction.

## When to use

- Use when users need to understand a serious consequence before deciding what to do.
- Place it immediately before the related action or decision when timing matters.

## When not to use

- Do not use for ordinary guidance, validation errors or successful outcomes.
- Do not show several warning-text components on one page, which makes it difficult to identify the most important consequence.

## Anatomy

- **Warning container (required):** A govuk-warning-text groups the icon and message.
- **Decorative icon (required):** The exclamation mark is hidden from assistive technology using aria-hidden.
- **Warning message (required):** Strong text contains a visually hidden Warning label followed by the consequence.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `div` | `govuk-warning-text` | A serious consequence on the standard page background. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- No GOV.UK JavaScript module is required.
- Keep the warning adjacent to the action or information it qualifies.

## Accessibility contract

- Retain aria-hidden on the icon and the govuk-visually-hidden Warning text.
- The consequence must be understandable without seeing the icon, weight or layout.
- Do not use warning styling as the only indication that an action has risk.

## Content rules

- State the specific consequence in plain language.
- Avoid vague phrases such as “Warning: be careful” and do not duplicate “Warning” in visible text.
- Tell users what they can do to avoid the consequence when that is not obvious.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.text`
- `govuk.color.inverse-text`
- `govuk.typography.weight.bold`
- `govuk.border.standard`

## HTML examples

### Registration warning

```html
<div class="govuk-warning-text">
  <span class="govuk-warning-text__icon" aria-hidden="true">!</span>
  <strong class="govuk-warning-text__text">
    <span class="govuk-visually-hidden">Warning</span>
    You can be fined up to £5,000 if you do not register.
  </strong>
</div>
```
